gui.packingcube.ghost_help: Sample slot: left-click to copy the cursor item, right-click to clear. No physical items are stored.
gui.packingcube.no_exclude_rules: No exclude rules: all otherwise eligible items can be inserted.
gui.packingcube.no_rules: No include rules: nothing can be inserted.
gui.packingcube.no_tags: No tag candidates. Select a sample.
gui.packingcube.pickup_pouch_help: When ON, this installed pouch automatically stores matching ground items. OFF disables only this pouch. Manual insertion still follows the filter. Loose pouches do not auto-pick up. Open backpacks are temporarily skipped.
gui.packingcube.pickup_priority_help: 0-9: higher first across all backpacks. Ties: equipped backpack, inventory order, then left to right. Full pouches pass the remainder on.
gui.packingcube.rules_help: Shows the current mode. Click to switch Include/Exclude without clearing rules. Manual insertion is filtered too.
gui.packingcube.sample_help: Hold an item and click the sample slot. Nothing is consumed. Right-click to clear.
gui.packingcube.settings_space_help: Not enough room beside the inventory. Reduce GUI Scale or widen the window to open settings.
message.packingcube.close_menu: Close the bag screen before editing filters.
message.packingcube.empty_cursor: Put down the cursor stack before switching screens.
message.packingcube.filter_cleared: Filter reset to include mode with no rules. Stored items were not changed.
message.packingcube.filter_limit: A filter supports up to %s rules in total.
message.packingcube.hold_filter: Hold a Small Storage Pouch in your main hand.
message.packingcube.legacy_overflow: Recovered %s items from the old bag slots. %s items are still retained; free inventory space and reopen the bag.
tooltip.packingcube.filter_more: %s more (view all rules in the bag filter screen)
